| description = He is located on the 2nd floor balcony to the main room on the left when walking in.

Lord Lyfyx has a strange reaction to asking him who 'doowruB fo xyfyl droL' is. This is seemingly some kind of easter egg, until you take into consideration what questline he is a part of- the [[Dragon Scales Quest]]. The quest is comprised of collecting scales from three special dragons, [[Azdalin]], [[Gylton]], and Xyfyl. After bringing Lyfyx a Tektite and Peridot, he tugs at his arms to give you his dragon scale, which identifies as Xyfyl; Lord Lyfyx is Xyfyl in disguise, which is why he insults you when you ask him about who Xyfyl is.

Burwood is suspiciously similar to [[Burning Wood]] as well, the location of the other two dragons.
